d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi ne udyog jagat se krishi kshetr men nivesh barhane ka aagrah kiya. phikki ke shatabdi varsh sammelan ko sanbodhit karte hue unhonne viksit rashtr ke nirman ke lie indiya pharst ki bhavna ko sarvopri rakhne par jor diya. pradhanmantri ne kaha ki krishi kshetr men nivesh aur aadhunik taknik ke istemal se desh ki arthavyavastha ko naee majbuti mil sakti hai. idhar, jharkhand men rajy sthapna divas pakhvara ke tahat vibhinn jilon men karyakramon ka aayojan kiya ja raha hai. is dauran labhukon ke bich parisanpattiyon ka vitran aur grih pravesh jaise karyakram aayojit…
